## What changed

Describe the user-visible behavior and the evidence behind it.

## Validation

- [ ] `npm run release:check` passes
- [ ] New native formats include synthetic or redacted fixtures
- [ ] Parser changes preserve filename and line provenance
- [ ] Solver changes test secondary collisions and deterministic order
- [ ] Documentation and limitations are updated
- [ ] No personal config data, secrets, or `Co-authored-by` trailer is included
